title: UGREEN Vertical Laptop Stand Holder for Desk Compatible with MacBook Pro, MacBook Air Stand Vertical Aluminum Adjustable for Up to 17.3 Inch Gaming Laptop, Gray Review
reviews: Great, low profile and works as expected! Very happy with the look of this with my MacBook on my desk. The finish is almost identical and it works very well for how simple the design is. Less moving parts=less thigns to break. I personally use it with my MacBook standing vertically and it still works as desired.

Great Desk Organizer if You Use Your Laptop Docked Most of the Time This is a nice desk accessory because it helps save space and makes the setup look cleaner right away. If your laptop usually stays connected to a monitor and accessories, storing it vertically is a smart way to free up desk room without losing access to it. The aluminum look is nice too, so it fits well with modern desk setups. Pros: ✅ Saves desk space ✅ Helps create a cleaner setup ✅ Adjustable design is useful ✅ Looks nice on a desk Cons: ⚠️ Best for people who use their laptop docked/closed regularly ⚠️ Fit depends on laptop thickness and case setup Overall, a smart and clean desk organization upgrade.

Quality equal to something that is 3x as pricey indistinguishable from something a big brand like rain design or even apple would charge 10x for. The silver is perfectly matched to my MacBook - not "close enough" but genuinely identical. The aluminum is thick, edges are smooth, and the rubber padding grips without scratching. The adjustable width mechanism feels heavy and luxurious. It holds my 15" macbook air rock steady, zero wobble, and the rubber base means it's not going anywhere on my desk. I was worried initially because the large MBA is really thin but big, so I was concerned that it would wobble or be off balance if sitting vertically. ZERO issues with that. This stand is rock solid. The whole thing has that dense, cold-to-the-touch feel of actual quality aluminum, not the hollow nonsense you usually get at this price. It looks super good next to my Studio Display and looks aesthetically continuous with all of my Apple gear. Awesome product, and AMAZING value. Keep going, UGREEN!!!

UGREEN Vertical Laptop Stand Holder for Desk I always use a vertical laptop stand for my MacBooks since I have an external monitor, keyboard, and mouse connected. The UGREEN Vertical Laptop Stand is perfect for this setup. It is made of high-quality aluminum, feels very sturdy, and fits right in with the clean look of my desk. I can easily tuck my MacBook behind the monitor to save space, and the stand keeps it secure without taking up much room. One of the best features is the adjustable width, which allows it to fit anything from a MacBook Air to a 17.3-inch gaming laptop. The adjustment feels solid and reliable, and the design leaves enough space around the laptop for proper airflow. Overall, it is a well-built, versatile stand that I would definitely recommend for keeping a workspace neat and organized.
Nice one Very sturdy and adjustable stand. Doesn't leave any marks or scratches: everything is nicely soft padded. Good weight on the desk and matches my laptop color.
Worth it. Solid construction, works with my Dell Inspiron 16. Holds it upright without gripping the laptop too hard, and leaves more than enough room for the laptop to cool itself.

Space-Saving and Sleek! This upright laptop holder has made a huge difference in keeping my desk organized and clutter-free. It holds my laptop securely without wobbling, and the adjustable width is perfect for different devices. The design is modern and minimal, so it looks great on my desk without being distracting. I love that I can dock my laptop vertically while connected to my monitor—everything stays tidy and runs cooler. Great quality and totally worth it if you’re looking to maximize your workspace!
